Blissful Wizard #32 x Blissful Wizard

-------------

Breakwater Small Batch is a series of limited releases created to bring you closer to our strain selection process. This project gives you the opportunity to explore strains that are still being evaluated for large scale production. Some of these strains may even return to our menu.

-------------

Blissful Wizard Bx1 originates from the renowned Maine breeder, the Captain’s Connection, also known as CookieMaine. Celebrated for his love of cookie varieties, CookieMaine burst into prominence with his original Blissful Wizard cross. The lore of this variety became so legendary that he sought to stabilize it into a seed line. Blissful Wizard Bx1 is a backcross of a standout male and a potent phenotype (#32), selected by CookieMaine during a pheno hunt of the original Blissful Wizard.

Showcasing classic Cookie genetics, Blissful Wizard Bx1 develops with beautiful structure, abundant branches, and dense, bulbous flowers. While live plants exude a dank GMO funkyness that parallels our Blue & Cream, the cured flower delivers a complex, layered bouquet of peppery kush and subtle creaminess. This phenotype may lean sedative, inducing heavy eyelids and body relaxation.

In their quest to harness and fortify the characteristics of classic cannabis lineages, Reservoir created CHEMDOG IBL. CHEMDOG IBL is the first inbred line released based on their Chemdog D clone. They used their original Chemdog IBL (not to be confused with this CHEMDOG IBL, the descendant) as the pollen source for this project. We initially sourced GAK Getaway from Ice Cold Seeds in Michigan as a hash exclusive strain but once we became familiar with this strain's beautiful, dense, aromatic buds we knew we had to offer it up as Premium Flower. GAK Getaway is a cross of Pie Dough, a relentless resin machine, well known in the community and also one half of some of our in-house favorites, like Pie Eyed. However, the cut of Pie Dough used in this project is different from the one popularized in Maine by the legendary MegaRaw Melts and Crystal Rose Seed Co. This particular Pie Dough was pollinated with a GAK male plant. The moniker “GAK” is an abbreviated fusion of its parents: G13 Haze and AK47.

While many of our phenotypes produced the gassy, hazy, and musky aromas expected of this lineage, our selected pheno of GAK Getaway as uniquely fruity and tropical, with a touch of funk - similar to the funky mango banana scent of ripe paw paw fruit. Though pheno-hunting is always something of a lottery, we often seem to hit the jackpot with Crystal Rose Seed Co.’s genetics. Producing winners like Pie Eyed, Wave Runners, and Watermelon Otai, their complex, one-of-a-kind crosses always have us coming back for more, and Grape Crepe is no different.

Prior to the creation of Grape Crepe, Crystal Rose had the opportunity to work with MegaRaw’s brand-building, in-house selected phenotype of Pie Dough, and he crossed it with his own Pie Eyed selection to create Pie Dough Bx1. He then crossed Pie Dough Bx1 with Grape Pie Wedding Crasher, a male known for its abundant resin and grape terps, to create Grape Crepe. Our cultivation team has selected two phenotypes of Grape Crepe: one for flower and the other for solventless extracts, and we have found this cultivar to be a wild improvement on the grape category as a whole.

Opening a jar of our flower phenotype, Grape Crepe #61, launches a purple wave of grape juice and grape candy streaked with a subtle gassy note – an aroma that translates impeccably to flavor with vaporization or combustion. A balanced combination of stress-melting relaxation and uplifting euphoria is consistent with its lineage of Pie Dough, Grape Pie, Wedding Cake, and Purple Punch.

Our selected phenotype grows with moderate vigor and a healthy spread of branches that bloom conical, Christmas tree-shaped flowers. Expect a slightly sour, diesel fuel-tinged aroma up front from the Headband lineage, followed by a heavy-hitting chemical cleaner and fuel finish – classic ChemD.

While the flowering time runs longer than average, the payoff is worth the wait – a potent, complex expression of sour, skunk, and chem exploding from every bud.

Crystal Rose Seed Co. is a family affair out of Maine started by the DoSiDos-loving “Dosi Drew'' and his partner Amanda. Focused on breeding cultivars with high resin content and unique terpene profiles, Crystal Rose has made a name for itself in Maine and beyond.

After sparking a friendship with fellow Maine transplant and grower MegaRaw Melts, the two decided to embark on a breeding collaboration. Crystal Rose is fortunate enough to be the only breeder to this day given the opportunity to use Mega’s fabled Pie Dough female. They pollinated Pie Dough with their own powerhouse male, OGKB/TK. Bud structure in the offspring is dense, with plants tending to have a cookie/chem-type structure. The resin is extremely greasy and almost wet. Aromas and flavors range from sweet dough and gas to cherry pie and hash.

Our phenotype (as is often the case with other Pie Eyed phenos) has a balanced mix of effects, giving the user vivid cerebral clarity as well as an overall sense of relaxation. The user can expect an initial feeling of alertness and sociability, followed by a calm that soothes the stresses of a long day. Some may notice more sedative effects with a release of pressure behind the eyes and a heavying of the eyelids.

Fruit-forward cannabis strains have dominated the market in the current cannabis climate, often at the expense of other flavors. However, at Breakwater, our cultivators are passionate about exploring this plant’s limitless diversity, relentlessly seeking out flavors of times past that speak to the complex history of cannabis. For this reason, Sour Super Skunk is a meaningful selection for us, preserving and expressing its own unique chapter in that history.

If there is one thing East Coast cannabis has been recognized for, it’s the gas profiles and Sour varieties. Sour Super Skunk, from Top Dawg Seeds, evokes memories of 1990s NYC and the age of Sour and Skunk. We carefully combed through nearly a thousand seeds with a Sour lineage before finally landing on this stalwart classic. Nose-hair-tingling, eye-burning, mouth-watering, sulphury sour and skunk aromas are in full effect with this phenotype. These aromas bring us back to a time when cannabis was still outlawed and heavily stigmatized. As such, quality Sour and Skunk varietals have been hard to track down. Critical genetic preservation has made it possible to rediscover plants that some have sworn were lost forever. We thank JJ of Top Dawg for this valuable contribution.

Large, chunky Sour Diesel shaped buds fill the canopy and the air with acrid tartness. The cured flower releases notes of gas, sour, and a gentle sweetness. Back-alley New York City terps smack you in the face as soon as the lid lifts from the jar. The live hash rosin packs its own unique punch with all the sour and skunk one could need. Effects are versatile and can range from uplifting and energizing to heavy-eyed, couch-locking, sedative effects–depending on the person, mood, and time of day.

Live Rosin is a solventless concentrate made using fresh frozen cannabis plant material. The frozen plant material is first put through an ice water extraction process which separates the trichome glands from the plant material. Those trichome glands are then dried using extremely cold temperatures to remove the moisture. Once dried, the collection of trichome glands are pressed through a 25 micron filter utilizing heat and pressure to melt the rest away from the trichome glands and plant material. The result is an un adulterated form of cannabis resin that is a direct representation of the cultivar used to make it.

RSO, or Rick Simpson Oil, is named after a Canadian cancer patient turned cannabis activist. RSO is sometimes referred to as a "whole plant" or "full spectrum" extract because it retains the full cannabinoid, terpene, and chlorophyll profile of the source material by using specific solvents.

RSO was originally created to be used as a topical. Rick Simpson applied this activated concentrate directly to areas of concern on his skin. Today, patients use RSO in a variety of ways, including topically, orally by itself or mixed with food, and sublingually.

384.desc: Blue Limeade from Garden Greens is a balanced hybrid celebrated for its sweet, juicy fruit character and zesty lime sparkle on the nose and palate. The aroma blends bright lime, ripe berry-blue notes, and a subtle herbal edge, all wrapped in a distinctly “dank” funk that keeps it loud and grown-up rather than candy-soft. On the inhale, expect a burst of citrus-lime and soft sweetness, followed by a slightly earthy, herbal exhale that lingers on the tongue like a terp-heavy limeade. Visually, Blue Limeade typically presents dense, chunky buds with deep emerald tones and occasional purple flashes, dusted in a sparkling layer of trichomes that underscore its potency and bag appeal. The high is often described as full-bodied yet balanced: a quick cerebral lift that smooths into an easygoing, relaxed state without immediate couchlock, making it suitable for afternoon or early evening sessions. Altogether, Blue Limeade is a flavor-first hybrid that pairs expressive citrus-funk terps with a rounded, mood-brightening effect profile ideal for everyday connoisseurs.

Its euphoric, creative, and calming effects make it a favorite among those seeking relief from anxiety, depression, stress, and writing strain descriptions. If you missed our Test Kitchen drop of “Z x Sherbanger”, now is your chance to get your hand on what’s sure to be one of our biggest hits of the year.

Deep Breath is a great choice for any indica lover who's after a fast-hitting high that will get them relaxed in no time flat. The high starts almost as soon as you exhale, launching through the mind with an energizing effect. You'll be filled with sociability and happiness accompanied by a boost in creativity that gets your artistic juices flowing. A relaxing body high accompanies this happy boost, keeping you anchored without dampening your energy level in the slightest.

The high is stimulating yet heavy, locking the body while the mind drifts in all directions. It’s so familiar, I can’t really tell if this is yesterday or today. It’s today, right? Whew. That gave me déjà vu.

Covered in trichromes, Ice Wookie is dripping in a different kind of diamonds. Think of it as Chewbacca with swagger—a little more sparkle and a lot more shine. This strain is not very mindful, not very demure. With a Chem leaning nose and hints of Girl Scout Cookies on the smoke, Ice Wookie packs a punch then smiles at you with an iced out grill.

404.desc: Lemon Cherry Gelato (Gelato x Zkittlez) is an old school favorite—so much so that running joke is that everything “candy” we like is actually just LCG renamed. Well, jet’s clear things up: this is the OG LCG. It’s not Black Cherry Runtz (or obama runtz, or kamikazi, or even Deez runtz), It’s not Lemon Cherry Zkittlez. Think it might be Pink Runtz? Nope. Super Lemon Cherry? Super nope. That “mystery bag” your plug swore was exclusive? He lied, but that was probably LCG. Our Lemon Cherry Gelato is bright, citrusy, and creamy with a cherry kick that makes it one of our all time favorites. The high lifts you up with a euphoric burst before settling into a smooth, mellow calm. It’s a balanced hybrid, perfect for when you want to keep your vibe

405.desc:
Lemon Cherry Gelato is an indica-dominant hybrid with delicious flavor and well-balanced effects. It is a cross of Sunset Sherbet, GSC, and what is thought to be another Gelato strain. Lemon Cherry Gelato typically has larger buds that are conical, rounded and dense. These buds are a visual treat, showcasing a spectrum of colors from yellowish-green to deep green and purple, all under a sparkling layer of trichomes.

Lemon Cherry Gelato tempts the palate with a luscious combination of fruity flavors, creating a delectable dessert-like experience for the senses. Its aroma is a delightful medley, combining citrusy lime, berries, and a subtle citrus undertone, making it as aromatic as it is flavorful. When it comes to flavor, Lemon Cherry Gelato tastes even sweeter than it smells and is compared to a delicious desert that has lemon and cherry notes. The taste is both tangy and sweet.

The high is as smooth as your favorite Sunday morning playlist. Perfect for those days when you want to feel inspired but not too inspired--because let's be real, nobody's trying to run a marathon here. Just enough energy to vibe out, sketch something cool, or lose yourself in a Netflix binge.

Warning: May cause extreme couch appreciation and sudden cravings for junk food.

The taste of Red Hotz is just like its namesake treat, with a sweet and sugary berry candy taste accented by zesty, spicy oranges and a hint of fresh red fruits. The aroma is very similar, with a spicy, peppery orange overtone accented by hints of earthiness and a touch of sweet fruity red candies. The Red Hotz high will wash over you quickly, filling your mind with a soaring sense of bright energy. 449.desc:
Cured Hash Oil

Animal Tsumani x Milk Bath

This blend of Animal Tsumani and Milk Bath brings bold pepper and spice up front, finishing with a floral sweetness, citrus lift, and a fast-settling, grounded effect.

Spec: TAC 75.39% | THC 69.42% | Terps 5.39%

Not every day hits the same, and this is the form for when you want things clean and quiet: our vapes start with our own Goodies flower, cured and pulled into hash oil using Advanced Phytonics — a low-pressure, non-chlorinated process that skips the harsh solvents and CO2 systems most vapes rely on. Produced and distributed by Magic Garden Botanicals, it's a cleaner way to carry the full flavor and effect of the plant wherever you go.

Crafted using Advanced Phytonics extraction, this Cured Hash Oil captures the plant’s desirable compounds through a specialized low-pressure process. The technology uses non-chlorinated fluorohydrocarbons, known as phytosols, as an alternative to traditional organic solvents and supercritical CO2 extraction.

Designed to provide an efficient and precise extraction, the process helps preserve the character of the cured plant material while using lower-pressure equipment and a more streamlined production method.

Bread and Butter (Donkey Butter × Baker’s Dozen) is a savory dessert Indica that puts Donkey Butter’s garlic-funk on Baker’s Dozen bakery dough. Flavor is toasted bread, melted butter, and nutty cookie up front, with earthy spice, a little garlic, and light fuel on the finish. Effects come on happy and calm, then drop into deep body relaxation that can lock you down at higher doses. Best for evening shoppers who want bakery terps with real savory punch—not candy fruit, not straight GMO.

465.desc:
Grape Bubblegum is a hybrid of Cake Mints / Platinum GSC × Gelato GMO, stacking Wedding Cake mint and Platinum Girl Scout Cookies on Gelato cream and GMO gas. The pouch smells like old-school grape gum with a modern twist: sweet grape and ripe berry up front, then floral candy, a little garlic, and a peppery earth finish. The high stays balanced, happy and lifted at first, then a calm body ease that melts tension without knocking you out on the first pull. It is for Cookies and Gelato fans who want grape instead of straight dessert, GMO smokers who still want candy, and anyone shopping for hybrid flower that tastes like grape bubblegum and keeps the evening easy.

Grape Gum over Pepper and Garlic: Sweet grape and ripe berry come first, then floral candy, a little GMO garlic, and a peppery earth finish. Candy first, funk after.
Happy lift that stays easy: A bright head opens the session, and the body eases in without instant couch-lock, built for a relaxed evening that stays present.

Flavor is sharp lemon cleaner and haze-citrus first, then spice, pine, and a funky gas finish. Effects are fast and cerebral—energizing, focused, and creative with only a light body ease, so it stays daytime-friendly. Best for customers who want lemon that actually wakes them up, not another dessert cake: morning shoppers, creatives, and anyone chasing terpinolene haze plus diesel instead of couch-lock.

467.desc: Mandarin Cookies is a sativa of Forum Cut Cookies × Mandarine Sunset, stacking the classic Girl Scout Cookies dough and fuel on Ethos citrus. The jar smells like a peeled mandarin over a cookie tin: sharp orange zest and sweet gas up front, then pine, pepper, and a doughy herbal finish. The high opens bright and focused, talkative and creative, with a calm body underneath so it stays daytime instead of racy or sleepy. It is for Cookies fans who want orange instead of mint, citrus-sativa smokers, and anyone shopping for a flower that tastes like mandarin peel and cookie dough and keeps the afternoon moving.

468.desc: Mind Melter (Strawberry Jelly × Mind Flayer) is a Solfire Gardens hybrid that puts loud strawberry jam on Mind Flayer frost and punch. Flavor is thick strawberry jam and chocolate-covered berries up front, with cream, grape, citrus, and a sweet earthy-pine finish. Effects hit fast and euphoric—mood lift and a little creative spark—then slide into deep body calm without always locking you down. Best for customers who want real strawberry terps and purple bag appeal, shopping an anytime hybrid that melts stress without tasting like generic candy.

469.desc: Ouzo 7 is a Gelato × Gelato GMO Sativa that stacks Sunset Sherbet × Thin Mint GSC cream on a GMO (Chem D × GSC) cut, then leans into the anise-and-citrus nose the name promises. The jar smells like black licorice and fennel over sweet gelato, lemon zest, and pine, with a peppery GMO-gas finish instead of straight garlic funk. The high usually opens bright and talkative—happy, a little focused—then eases into a calm body melt that stays functional longer than a heavy GMO nightcap. It’s for flavor hunters who want dessert without candy-only terps, Gelato fans who like a herbal twist, and anyone shopping a balanced evening Sativa that still feels social before it settles.

470.desc: Peach Crescendo is an indica, (Chem D × I-95) × (Mandarin Cookies × Peach Rings), stacking Chem fuel and East Coast gas on orange Cookies and peach candy. The jar smells like a bag of peach rings cracked over a garage: sweet peach and tropical citrus up front, then sour spice, earth, and a sharp chemical diesel finish. The high creeps in happy and clear, then rolls into a tingly, heavy body that can park you on the couch if you keep going. It is for Chem and Mandarin Cookies fans who want fruit on the gas, nightcaps that still start bright, and anyone shopping for an indica flower that tastes like peach candy and puts the day down.

Original Glue, once known as “Gorilla Glue #4,” is an indica dominant hybrid strain (63% indica/37% sativa) created through crossing the infamous Chem's Sister X Sour Dubb X Chocolate Diesel strains. Known for its body-melting effects, Original Glue is perfect for kicking back on those nights when rest just won't come easily. The high comes on with a building effect, slowly filling your mind with a lifted euphoria and light creative energy. As your mind lifts higher and higher into happiness, an almost glue-like sense will kick in, leaving you mentally stuck in this blissful state and without a care in the world. This effect will soon spread throughout the rest of your body, leaving you hopelessly couch-locked and immovable for hours on end. It is often said to be perfect for treating ADD or ADHD, Bipolar Disorder, chronic pain, depression, chronic fatigue, insomnia, appetite loss or nausea and migraines or headaches. This bud has a spicy chemical chocolate flavor with a heavily diesel exhale that turns slightly sweet the more that you toke. The aroma follows the same profile, although with a heavy peppery pungency to it, too. Gorilla Glue #4 buds have small rounded forest green nugs with furry amber hairs and a coating of tiny amber-tinted white crystal trichomes that are dripping with sweet sticky resin.

899.desc: Afternoon Delight is a sativa dominant hybrid strain created through a cross of the insanely delicious Banana X Schrom X Tangie strains. Afternoon Delight will tickle your tongue with sweet citrus flavors that are accented by rich pine and skunky diesel. The aroma is very similar, with a skunky fruitiness that's accented by tropical citrus and a pungent hit of diesel as the nugs are burned. The effects of Afternoon Delight are incredibly relaxing and calming in nature, exactly the strain you want for a lazy afternoon. You'll feel an even head and body buzz that's cloudy and spacey with a slight couch-lock and long-lasting effects. However, these effects are pretty mild in nature unless you smoke a little too much of this delight. These effects coupled with its medium average THC level make Afternoon Delight perfect for treating chronic stress or anxiety, insomnia, chronic pain, and depression. This bud has lumpy popcorn-shaped bright neon green nugs that are covered in thin orange hairs and a super sticky coating of sweet resin.

Crystal Rose Seed Co. is a family affair out of Maine started by the DoSiDos-loving “Dosi Drew'' and his partner Amanda. Focused on breeding cultivars with high resin content and unique terpene profiles, Crystal Rose has made a name for itself in Maine and beyond.

After sparking a friendship with fellow Maine transplant and grower MegaRaw Melts, the two decided to embark on a breeding collaboration. Crystal Rose is fortunate enough to be the only breeder to this day given the opportunity to use Mega’s fabled Pie Dough female. They pollinated Pie Dough with their own powerhouse male, OGKB/TK. Bud structure in the offspring is dense, with plants tending to have a cookie/chem-type structure. The resin is extremely greasy and almost wet. Aromas and flavors range from sweet dough and gas to cherry pie and hash.

Our phenotype (as is often the case with other Pie Eyed phenos) has a balanced mix of effects, giving the user vivid cerebral clarity as well as an overall sense of relaxation. The user can expect an initial feeling of alertness and sociability, followed by a calm that soothes the stresses of a long day. Some may notice more sedative effects with a release of pressure behind the eyes and a heavying of the eyelids.
